verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing says it offers webhooks for building custom workflows, so this is a first-party capability, but the pack has only that one thin mention. The Slack/Discord/Teams sync does not count as programmatic webhooks. missing for 10: documentation of webhook registration (UI/API), supported event types, payload format, signing/secret verification, delivery/retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.
